description: This file defines the code-behind logic for the AdminPanel page in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for button clicks that navigate to different pages within the admin panel.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminPanel ASP.NET page, handling user interactions like button clicks to navigate within the admin interface.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently empty.

methods.description: Event handler for the home button click, currently empty.

methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.description: Transfers the user to the SetExam page.
